'''Surab''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the commander of the [[75th Legion]] under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vago]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] along with the rest of the legion.<ref name="TOR" />
